name: Waking Dream
text: While in your trance, you can blur the line between dreams and reality for others. You gain the Waking Dream focus spell, which you can use only while you're in a Daydream Trance. You gain a pool of Focus Points with 1 Focus Point, and you can Refocus by taking a nap for 10 minutes. You become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics, and your spellcasting attribute for these spells is Wisdom.
